text: Bitcoin has drifted lower over the past day while Ethereum held nearly flat, suggesting cautious consolidation among the two majors rather than conviction in either direction. Fear sentiment remains elevated at 33 despite a week-long improvement, and Bitcoin dominance at 56.7% reflects steady institutional preference for the largest asset as altcoins lag. Volume of $66B is moderate, indicating traders are waiting for clearer directional signals before committing capital.
